sources.name: Robert Shiller · U.S. stock-market workbook
sources.definition: Nominal S&P composite price, monthly averages. CAPE as provided by the author. Historical constituents differ before the modern S&P 500.
sources.note: Workbook ends at 2023-09. Provisional final observation excluded: 2023-09. Dividend reinvestment is not included in these price comparisons.

sources.name: Cboe · VIX daily history
sources.definition: Arithmetic monthly mean of daily VIX CLOSE observations, at least 10 per month.
sources.note: VIX history begins in 1990. Monthly averages do not preserve intraday spikes.

sources.name: Federal Reserve Bank of St. Louis · T10Y3M
sources.definition: Arithmetic monthly mean of daily 10-year minus 3-month Treasury spread, percentage points. At least 10 observations.
sources.note: The yield curve is commonly studied for recession prediction. This app separately tests a price-decline target, not recession prediction.

sources.name: Federal Reserve Bank of St. Louis · STLFSI4
sources.definition: Arithmetic monthly mean of weekly financial-stress index observations, at least 3 per month.
sources.note: A revised composite with a full-sample normalization. These are current-vintage observations, not what was necessarily published at each historical date.
